title: Prevent overlapping time intervals
gherkin:
Feature: Overlap Prevention Rule
  Scenario: System prevents overlapping time intervals
    Given two events are scheduled
    When the second event's start time falls within the first event's duration
    Then the system should reject the second event
    And display an overlap conflict error message
rationale: Validates that the overlap prevention rule detects and blocks time-based overlaps, which is a common requirement for scheduling systems.
generationSummary: Overlap prevention rule - Test cases for validating that overlapping elements, events, or data are properly detected and prevented from occurring simultaneously or in conflicting states.
